label: Ezra

text.BHSA NEH 12:1: וְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָל֛וּ עִם־זְרֻבָּבֶ֥ל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֖ל וְיֵשׁ֑וּעַ שְׂרָיָ֥ה יִרְמְיָ֖ה עֶזְרָֽא׃
text.KJV NEH 12:1: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

A.name: Ezra
A.line: son of Seraiah (EZR 7:1), scribe skilled in the Law (EZR 7:6)
A.notes: as "priest" would be a descendant of Aaron
family: son-of seraiah-2 (Seraiah, the chief priest (2KI 25:18) who was killed by the king of B)
priest-of yhvh (YHVH, the God of Israel)
scribe-of yhvh (YHVH, the God of Israel)
descendant-of hilkiah-2 (Hilkiah, the high priest of King Josiah's reign (2KI 22:4, 2CH 34:9))

B.name: Ezra
B.line: Priest who returned with Zerubbabel and Jeshua; ancestor of a priestly house later headed by Meshullam
family: companion-of zerubbabel-2 (Zerubbabel, returned to Judah after the Babylonian captivity (EZR 2:2, N)

why: The Hebrew lists Ezra among the priests who went up with Zerubbabel and Jeshua, exactly matching B’s stated identity. Seraiah, Jeremiah, and Ezra are separate entries in the list; Seraiah is not identified here as Ezra’s father.
